patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks Lumenate Premium without a subscription.

patches.name: Hide Ads
patches.description: Hides Google, Nimbus, Moloco, Liftoff, in-feed promo tiles, Inbox banners, and the Go Premium bar. Note: patching OfferUp breaks the listing map embed (Maps API key is tied to the Play Store signature).

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks ASL Bloom Premium lessons and features.

patches.name: Disable Analytics
patches.description: Prevents Adjust and Firebase Analytics from collecting or sending analytics.

patches.name: Unlock Plus
patches.description: Unlocks Expand Plus without a subscription.
